pull.body:
Adds a 'romberg' entry to RULES (vermilion #D55E00, diamond marker, label 'Romberg extrapolation') and refreshes report/figures/data/{errors,fits,reference}.csv from experiment-repo results/ (includes Romberg rows, fits).

Not included: regenerated PNGs/render_checks.txt, for figtab-repo to regenerate after merge. My local run with this change passes the fit-consistency checks for Romberg, but the layout check 'no label/legend overlaps' FAILS on both figures (order labels collide with each other / the legend once a fourth series is added); that layout fix is figtab-repo's. Report must stay one page.
pull.title: Distinct marker and legend label for the Romberg series
